reviews.title: The CORSAIR HX1200i
reviews.comment: The CORSAIR HX1200i has been excellent in my build. It’s very quiet, runs cool, and handles high-end hardware without any issues. The fully modular cables made the build look much cleaner, and overall it just feels like a very reliable premium power supply.
reviews.author: EdansO

reviews.title: Great product!
reviews.comment: I like this new power supply from Corsair. The cables are much easier to use compared to my older Corsair power supply.
reviews.author: Jgamer

reviews.title: Quiet, Powerful, and Worth the Upgrade
reviews.comment: I just picked up the Corsair HX1200i for my new build, and it’s been great so far. The install was super easy thanks to the fully modular cables, and the unit itself feels really solid and high quality. My system runs a high-end GPU, and the power delivery has been perfectly stable with no weird noises or coil whine. What I like most is how quiet it is—I honestly can’t hear it at all while gaming. It’s definitely not cheap, but it feels like one of those parts you buy once and don’t have to worry about for years. Overall, really happy with the purchase.
reviews.author: Clem

reviews.title: 1200 corsair, no dedicated GPU output
reviews.comment: I am happy with my power supply and has not failed yet. Seems well build and like the option to be able to monitor power from the corsair dashboard. Only thing that was a surprise was the lack of a dedicated 12v 2x6 connector. They have the conversion cable but buying what I thought  would be the higher end power supply would come with the dedicated GPU connector. O well no biggie
